 This is a paid press release. Contact the press release distributor directly with any inquiries. Heru PretestPro™ Named CES® Innovation Awards 2027 Honoree as Heru Surpasses 2 Million Eyes Tested
 Business Wire Tue, November 17, 2026 at 4:30 AM PST 4 min read Third CES Innovation Award for the Bascom Palmer Eye Institute spinout recognizes an AI-powered pretest that covers more than half of the comprehensive eye exam in about two minutes, hands-free 
 MIAMI, November 17, 2026 --( BUSINESS WIRE )--Heru, Inc. today announced that Heru PretestPro™ has been named a CES® Innovation Awards 2027 Honoree in the Digital Health category by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA)®. The recognition comes as Heru surpasses 2 million eyes tested on its platform, and the company is now working with 12 of the 15 largest vision care organizations in the United States. 
 This is Heru's third CES Innovation Award and its first in Digital Health. The company was previously honored at CES in the Virtual & Augmented Reality category. The CES Innovation Awards program received a record of more than 3,600 entries for CES 2026 across 36 categories. Entries are evaluated by an independent panel of industry experts, designers, engineers and media on innovation, functionality and design. 
 More than half of the exam in about two minutes 
 Heru PretestPro runs four pretest eye exams in approximately 90 seconds: a screening visual field, a near cover test, quantitative pupillometry, and extraocular motility. With Heru's visual acuity test, it completes more than half of the components of a comprehensive eye exam in about two minutes. The patient puts on a commercial VR headset and the exams run in the background, driven by Heru's cloud-based AI algorithms, without a technician guiding each step. 
 Performed manually, these four exams require a technician working one-on-one with the patient, one test at a time, and typically take 5 to 10 minutes. PretestPro completes them in about 90 seconds, saving time for the technicians and giving patients a quick and easy start to their visit. Heru's platform includes FDA-registered tests and is HIPAA compliant and SOC 2 certified. 
 "The mission of the Bascom Palmer Eye Institute is to improve sight and advance eye care through compassionate patient care, innovative vision research, and ophthalmic education. Heru was born at our Institute, from the work of our own faculty members, and its technology has now tested more than two million eyes. PretestPro is an exceptional advance: more than half of the comprehensive eye exam is completed in about two minutes, giving a better experience for the patient, and more clinical data for the doctor," said Pradeep Y. Ramulu, MD, MHS, PhD, Director and Chair of the Bascom Palmer Eye Institute of the University of Miami Miller School of Medicine . "To see it honored at CES among the year's leading innovations in digital health is a proud moment for Bascom Palmer. It shows our mission at work, with innovation that began here now improving care for patients across the country." 
 Story Continues "We set out to make the pretest disappear within the first two minutes of the visit. Running these exams in the background on our AI algorithms in the cloud is what makes that possible, and it is why our customers call PretestPro a game changer: more of the exam completed in less time, with staff freed to care for patients," said Mohamed Abou Shousha, MD, PhD, founder and CEO of Heru. Abou Shousha, a Professor of Clinical Ophthalmology at Bascom Palmer, holds secondary appointments in the Miller School's departments of electrical and computer engineering, and biomedical engineering. As director of Bascom Palmer's Artificial Intelligence and Computer Augmented Vision Laboratory, he led a team of trailblazing physicians and scientists in the development of Heru. Heru's technology is the culmination of more than 15 years of clinical and scientific research and development. "Being recognized by CES on the same stage as the largest names in technology and healthcare, in the same week Heru surpassed two million eyes, confirms that eye care belongs at the center of digital health." 
 From Bascom Palmer to 2 million eyes 
 Bascom Palmer is currently ranked the No. 1 ophthalmology program in the United States by U.S. News & World Report . Heru's technology is licensed from the University of Miami, and its clinical validation studies were conducted at Bascom Palmer against the standard of care. 
 At CES 2027 
 Heru PretestPro will be featured among the CES Innovation Awards honorees at CES 2027 in Las Vegas, January 6-9, 2027. 
 About Heru 
 Heru, Inc. is a Miami-based vision care technology company that delivers AI-powered eye exams on commercial VR headsets. Its FDA-registered platform runs 13 diagnostic tests, has tested more than 2 million eyes, and the company works with 12 of the 15 largest vision care organizations in the United States. Heru is HIPAA compliant and SOC 2 certified. Heru is a three-time CES® Innovation Awards Honoree, across the digital health and virtual/augmented reality categories. Learn more at SeeHeru.com. 
 About Bascom Palmer Eye Institute 
 Bascom Palmer Eye Institute, the Department of Ophthalmology for the University of Miami Miller School of Medicine, part of UHealth – the University of Miami Health System, is ranked the nation's best in ophthalmology by U.S. News & World Report. The Institute has maintained its position as a premier destination for vision care through its commitment to unparalleled patient care, groundbreaking research, and exceptional medical education. For information on Bascom Palmer Eye Institute, visit www.bascompalmer.org .
